user_saw: In process listings, ordinary CLI commands looked like separate daemons, and `openclaw gateway call` had the same title as the long-running Gateway.
summary: The fix sets ordinary CLI process titles to `openclaw` and leaves the long-running Gateway with the distinct title `openclaw-gateway`.
reasoning: The parent of #73338 already named CLI processes after their top-level command, so `openclaw gateway call` could appear as `openclaw-gateway`. The #73338 diff gave that same title a new role as the long-running Gateway's identity and taught lock readers to accept the title alone, exposing the ambiguity in the existing naming scheme. The later CLI-name refactor preserved the command suffix.
